node.statement: Terminology check: the nonnegative grading is part of the hypothesis, not a consequence of A_0 = F·1. The allowed definition GT-hatcher-AT-hopf-algebra-definition begins with A = direct-sum_{n>=0} A_n; node 1.1 now explicitly adopts that convention for the compound phrase connected graded. Therefore A_n = 0 for n<0. In particular, exterior_Q(x) with |x|=-1 is a Z-graded counterexample only to a broader statement not asserted here, and is not an instance of node 1.1 or the root contract under its registered convention.
